command: set -euo pipefail; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do echo SAMPLE=$i; pactl -f json list sink-inputs | jq -c '[.[] | select(((.properties["application.name"] // "")|ascii_downcase)=="firefox" and ((.properties["media.name"] // "")|ascii_downcase|contains("chatgpt"))) | {index,corked,media:.properties["media.name"]}]'; pactl -f json list source-outputs | jq -c '[.[] | select(((.properties["application.name"] // "")|ascii_downcase)=="firefox" and ((.properties["media.name"] // "")|ascii_downcase|contains("chatgpt"))) | {index,corked,media:.properties["media.name"]}]'; sleep 0.5; done
